translated_text: My darling Alon, we are leaving tomorrow morning for La Corrèze, and I might be able to come back alone. In any case, I must be back in Paris where my darling is waiting for me. Afterwards, if necessary, if there is a response with Opera Mundi, there is no driver and we need one. So, my darling, maybe see you Sunday. I adore you, Baby.
